chunks: My father narrated to him, may God be pleased with him, saying: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Saif ibn Umayra, from Mudrik ibn al-Hazhaz

He said: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: O Mudrik! May God have mercy upon a servant who attracts the love of people to himself, so he narrates to them what they know, and leaves what they reject.
ai.seo_question: How should one communicate with people to gain their love and acceptance according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Khisal*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) outlines the principle of *al-hikmah* (wisdom) in da'wah, emphasizing the psychological art of meeting people at their level of understanding to foster receptivity. This approach reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on *mu'aradah* (concession) and contextual communication, ensuring that the message is not rejected due to cognitive dissonance or cultural disconnect. It serves as a practical guide for scholars and laypeople alike to build social harmony (*sulh*) before introducing deeper theological nuances.
